c1_form: y = intercept + beta * sim + gamma * articulation + delta * precision_contact
ridge_objective: task-balanced mean squared error + 0.10 * sum(coefficients^2), intercept unpenalized
calibration_note: Task-only additive attributes cannot change within-task rankings when the sim slope is positive. C1 is a calibration test; no ranking gain will be asserted for it without an observed ordering change.
pair_ties: Real ties excluded. Predicted ties reported as abstentions, excluded from sign accuracy, and scored 0.5 in separate tie-aware ranking loss.
mmrv: Reproduce source behavior exactly, including strict inversion and argument order; independently test ties.
uncertainty: 2000 bootstrap resamples of tasks within embodiment, descriptive only; no invented episode counts
negative_control: 100 within-embodiment permutations of the paired attribute vectors; fixed seed; compare MAE only
taxonomy_sensitivity: Set precision_contact=0 for carrot-on-plate and drawer tasks; no outcome-based revisions
c2: Exploratory LOTO pair-error shrinkage predictor from sim gap and the same two attributes, fixed ridge 0.10; no tuning on held-out labels; report risk/coverage only as exploratory if errors are too sparse
secondary_splits: leave-one-coarse-task-family-out where at least two families exist
leave-one-policy-family-out, flag fewer than two train families
external_gate: No task-level transport claims without documented exact task/model/embodiment/scoring match
